style: 2D TV cartoon (bold black outlines, flat colours)
inventory: none: the water bottle has no label, the purple polo has two plain buttons (round button on the placket, not a letter), the bag and blanket are unprinted

items.caption: shopping bag
items.risk: Model may print a shop logo or lettering on the paper bag (named as plain, still the top risk) or keep the orange cloth colour so it reads as the original; a paper bag on a picnic blanket is a mild context clash but the cue is unmistakable.

items.caption: tea bag
items.risk: Tea-bag tag or mug may get lettering (named blank; retouch if tiny); hand/string contact can look disconnected; scale of a giant tea bag may be rendered small, which weakens the cue.

items.caption: to drop a bag
items.risk: Mid-air states read ambiguously; the motion lines plus shadow carry the fall, but the model may glue the bag to the blanket (reads as a tipped bag) or keep it in his hands (reads as packing).

inventory: none readable: no logos on beanie, jacket, gloves or shovel; behind the window a small pale-blue rectangular object at the man's waist and the woman's Nordic sweater pattern (both pattern only, no letters); picture frames on the cabin wall

items.caption: way out
items.risk: Tunnel geometry may come out as a cave or igloo interior with no clear exit, or the exit too small; her turned head could change her face. The camera does not step back, so the opening must sit in the background, not in front of her.

items.caption: to block the way
items.risk: The moose may be placed behind her (path not blocked) or rendered too small; hand/face of the couple behind glass are tiny and may warp; risk of the husky being duplicated.

items.caption: to lose your way
items.risk: Model may keep part of the trench or the cabin (reads as clearing the way); heavy snow can smear her face; a 'looking around' moment is less direct than an action, so her lost expression must stay strong.

style: pen-and-ink hatched line drawing on white
inventory: none: no lettering, signature or watermark; plain white paper, the man's face is a blank oval

items.caption: water balloon
items.risk: Ink style makes water hard to show; the balloon may read as a plain balloon unless the water line and drips render; model may draw a face on the blank oval or add colour.

items.caption: balloon animal
items.risk: Model may keep the hot-air balloon stripes or draw a real dog; twisted-segment anatomy can come out as a blob; the man hanging from a single string is fantasy, as in the original.

items.caption: to blow up a balloon
items.risk: Hand-to-mouth contact and puffed cheek on a figure whose face was blank may come out messy; the man changing size breaks R4 on purpose (cue needs it); a party balloon may be mistaken for 'water balloon' if drips appear.

items.caption: to pop a balloon
items.risk: Burst graphics invite onomatopoeia lettering (forbidden twice; retouch if a stray mark); bird perched on a bursting balloon is physically odd; the model may draw an intact balloon with a bird (no burst = fails the cue).

inventory: none: open sea and sky only, no watermark, no boat parts, no lettering

items.caption: dolphin show
items.risk: Stadium backgrounds invite signs/banners/screens with text (forbidden, check closely); crowd faces small and smeary; the hoop may not wrap the dolphin correctly (dolphin in front of or behind it).

items.caption: pod of dolphins
items.risk: Multiple dolphins invite merged bodies or copy-paste clones (named, still the main risk); the model may shrink the dolphins so the group reads as dots.

items.caption: to feed a dolphin
items.risk: The pose change (leap -> rising head close to the boat) is needed for a large cue but may give dolphin anatomy errors; the hand may grow extra fingers or hold the fish unnaturally.

items.caption: to swim with a dolphin
items.risk: Partly-submerged bodies are hard: arm/leg count and where the swimmer's body continues under water may glitch; the mask/snorkel may get a brand mark.

style: doodle animation (black monoline + orange spot colour)
inventory: none: no lettering or logos; one tiny stray dark dot in the empty white area below the drawing (about x=376, y=994); the book cover is blank
originalRetouch: optional: clone out the 1-pixel stray dark dot below the drawing (about x=376, y=994); nothing else

items.caption: weight bench
items.risk: Plates may get weight numbers (forbidden; retouch if small); the model may keep slats from the park bench; a man reading on a weight bench in a park is odd but clear.

items.caption: picnic bench
items.risk: Model may draw a table next to the old park bench instead of an attached picnic bench (would read as 'park bench'); table perspective in doodle style may come out wonky.

items.caption: to paint a bench
items.risk: Model may keep him sitting (reads as reading), add a 'wet paint' sign with text (forbidden), or flood the orange beyond half the bench; brush hand anatomy.

items.caption: to share a bench
items.risk: Dog paws holding a book may merge; the man may shift; low risk of reading as a sibling.

inventory: none: no logos, emblems, lettering or watermark; plain brass door handle at right

items.caption: was calmed by a knight
items.risk: 3D-animated knight may drift photoreal or gain a heraldic emblem on chest/banners (forbidden); the crest may stay red (then it reads as still angry); armoured arms around a parrot can merge.

items.caption: has just calmed a baby
items.risk: Baby may look uncanny or slip toward a creepy hybrid; the tear plus dummy may be dropped; must stay clearly asleep (a crying baby would read as 'is calming').

items.caption: to calm down
items.risk: Model may keep the red crest (biggest risk; it carries 'angry'); the green parrot's full body was hidden in the source so its design may drift; the blue parrot may still be touching it.

items.caption: to calm a barking dog
items.risk: Wing stroking the head while hugging may produce an extra wing; the dog may look calm instead of barking; style drift to a different 3D look.

inventory: none: no shop sign, labels or logos on T-shirt, shirt, scarf or mannequin base; dark shop interior with ceiling spot lights and a person silhouette (no text); thin chain necklace on the mannequin

items.caption: shop-window mannequin
items.risk: Glass/reflection rendering may hide the mannequin or put it in front of the glass; shop windows invite lettering or price tags (forbidden); the woman's position change may alter her face.

items.caption: dressmaker's mannequin
items.risk: Tape measure may get digits (forbidden; local retouch if small); the woman kneeling is a big pose change at the frame edge; the dress form may keep a head.

items.caption: to dress a mannequin
items.risk: Removing the man leaves a large inpaint area (wall/frame may warp); half-on shirt over a raised arm may tangle with her hands; the woman may change face.

items.caption: to carry a mannequin
items.risk: Body-on-body overlap (mannequin limbs crossing his arms/head) is the main anatomy risk; mannequin may get duplicated; the man's waving hand from the source may survive as an extra arm.

inventory: none: no logos or lettering on backpacks, jackets or lantern; no watermark

items.caption: was leading knights to a castle
items.risk: Castle may be small in the haze (R7: named large); shields/armour may gain heraldry (forbidden); the torch flame may be lost into a lantern again.

items.caption: will be leading robots on Mars
items.risk: Robots/spacesuit often get numbers or flag patches (forbidden, retouch if tiny); count of robots may drift; the sky may go blue instead of pink.

items.caption: to lead a horse
items.risk: The horse may be placed in front of her and cover her; reins may detach from the hand; four-leg anatomy; she may end up mounted.

items.caption: to lead the race
items.risk: Race bibs strongly invite digits (forbidden; retouch if small, or drop bibs on retry); from the rear camera her lead depends on the runners' size/gap; daylight conversion may restyle the scene.

inventory: none: no logos or lettering; the straw hat's blue band is plain

items.caption: ran after a hat
items.risk: Era cue (village) may be too small behind the trees; the bonnet may land on her head instead of flying ahead; long dress may break the running-leg pose.

items.caption: will run after a hat
items.risk: Futuristic city invites glowing signs/screens with text (forbidden); the city may be too small to read as 'future' at thumbnail size.

items.caption: to run a race
items.risk: The model may add race numbers on vests or lettering on the tape (forbidden); new runners can duplicate her face; finish tape may be drawn as a ribbon not held by anyone.

items.caption: to run for the bus
items.risk: Bus fronts/backs invite route numbers, destination text or number plates (forbidden, the top risk); a stopped bus would read as 'catching' not 'running for'.

items.caption: to run out of breath
items.risk: Pose change may alter her face; she may be rendered sitting or kneeling; sweat drops may be lost (then it reads as just resting).
